0022600185.text: The Lakers (6-2, 1st in the Pacific, 4th in the West) head into this road game on a two-game winning streak and a 2-1 road record, while the Sacramento Kings (1-6, 5th in the Pacific and 4.5 games back, 15th in the West) are 0-2 at home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 128-104 win in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), and Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee).
